people.name: Abinadab
people.line: Kept the ark of God in his house

people.name: Ahio
people.line: Son of Abinadab, accompanied the ark from Kiriath-jearim

people.name: Uzzah
people.line: Died while moving the ark; place named after him

translations.web: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
translations.bsb: So they carried the ark of God from the house of Abinadab on a new cart, with Uzzah and Ahio guiding the cart.
translations.kjv: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
translations.asv: And they carried the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
